subject: general
question: Which of the following is the only permanent unit in the Panchayati Raj System ?
solution:
The correct answer is **Gram Sabha**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The only **permanent** unit in the **Panchayat Raj System is the Gram Sabha.**
 
• **Mukhiyas** and other** Panchayat members** serve terms of only **five years** beginning on the day set aside for the first meeting, although the villagers remain the same.
 
• A **Gram Panchayat **is the **lowest level **of the** three-tier Panchayat **Institutions, followed by a **Panchayat Samiti** at the Block level and a **Zila Parishad **at the District level. A tier is not the **Gram Sabha.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Panchayati Raj** 

 
 
• The Indian subcontinent gave rise to a political system known as the **Panchayat Raj,** which is mostly employed in **India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, and Nepal**. It is the earliest municipal governance system on the Indian subcontinent, with historical references to it dating back to** 250 CE.**
 
• **Raj** is the term for "**rule**," and **Panchayat** is the word for **"an assembly" (ayat) of five (panch). **In the past, **Panchayats** were made up of knowledgeable seniors who were selected and welcomed by the neighbourhood.
 
• These gatherings resolved disagreements between villages and individuals. Yet, these assemblies came in a variety of shapes.
 
• The **president mukhiya, sarpanch, or pradhan**, an elected or well-accepted office, were common names for the **Panchayat's head.​ **
